Storefront and customer routes of the contact module. Send `Accept-Language` (or `X-Locale` from a browser) on every call; a customer route needs the session cookie.

## POST /v1/contact

Submit a contact-form message

Request body: [ContactFormDto](#contactformdto).

Responses:

- `202`: Message received.
- `400`: Invalid input.

## Schemas

### ContactFormDto

- `fromName` (string, min length 1, max length 120, required).
- `fromEmail` (string, max length 254, required).
- `subjectLine` (string, min length 1, max length 200, required).
- `message` (string, min length 1, max length 5000, required).
